title: Mail labels
what: An account's labels, kept in the store and carried on messages as IMAP keywords of the service's own form, in src/labels.rs and src/routes/labels.rs.

title: Reading and changing mail
what: Mail read over IMAP: folders and their roles, lists and threads, message parts and bodies, the search box, flags, moves and deletion, and the inbox summary, in src/imap/ and the list and change routes.

title: Filter rules and spam senders
what: An account's filter rules, checked, ordered, planned over a message's headers and carried out by flag and move, and its always-spam senders, in src/rules.rs and src/routes/filters.rs.

title: Writing and sending mail
what: The composer opened new, as a reply or a forward, drafts saved and reopened, uploads staged, sending held for undo send then submitted, read receipts, known addresses, the account's settings and the service's own words, in src/writing/.

title: Sender logos
what: A sender domain's logo, found in its BIMI record or its site's icons, fetched only from the open web, checked and kept in the store, in src/avatars/ and src/routes/avatar.rs.

title: Inbox watcher
what: One IMAP connection per account standing in IDLE on the inbox, running the rules over new mail and saying on the event stream what changed and what arrived with its push; the accounts file followed, in src/watcher/.
